findings.title: Findings converge on the stream's use of the coordinator's refresh machinery as its control signals
findings.why_it_matters: Six findings trace to the debouncer/listener/last_update_success semantics; patches would interact.

findings.title: The listing-vs-held merge is undefined, and entity_revision can't order the non-entity fields a listing carries
findings.why_it_matters: Marks order entity values only; status and other fields have no merge rule.

findings.title: The on_connected resync path is unspecified
findings.why_it_matters: Each obvious resync path breaks subscribe-before-fetch.
findings.recommended: A: Locked async_refresh(), then check that last_success advanced

findings.title: D3's start after a good poll infers reachability from listener calls
findings.why_it_matters: Listeners fire on tolerated failures and pushes.
findings.recommended: B: Keep the coordinator listener, gated on last_success advancing

findings.title: Awaiting async_request_refresh() in on_message stalls the stream reader
findings.why_it_matters: The debouncer runs the first request inline.

findings.title: A push whose target the held listing lacks is ignored
findings.why_it_matters: A new instance's first set() can be lost for 30 s.
findings.recommended: A: Unknown same-boot target requests a refresh, with exclusions

findings.title: Nothing records why a push didn't land
findings.why_it_matters: The poll hides stream failures; no diagnostics.
findings.recommended: B: Debug log for each ignored push, with its reason
findings.chosen: B: Debug log for each ignored push, with its reason
findings.choice_reason: B + file an issue (filed as hass-hassette#81)

findings.title: An apply exception ends the stream every cycle; log suppression resets on connect
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: D2's debounced refresh can be dropped while a slow poll holds the lock
findings.why_it_matters: Status change waits up to 30 s.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: D1 A fans every push out to every entity and every platform's add_new walk
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The lossless-or-close assumption is stated more strongly than the server guarantees
findings.why_it_matters: A push that fails to build is lost until the next poll.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: D2's status_revision compare is seeded from the clock and ignores boot_id
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
